title: SubjectRule
description: Who a policy applies to. RBAC, ABAC, rule-based and time-based are NOT four engines: they are four views of one predicate, and every field below is ANDed with the others (FR-3.2). An empty rule matches nobody, never everybody.

principalMatch.description: One alternative in an OR list. Exactly one field is meaningful per entry.

assetOwner.description: Dynamic subject: whoever OpenMetadata lists as an owner of the asset being evaluated. Written once, applies to every table, and follows ownership changes without a policy edit (FR-3.2a).

source.description: Restrict which attribute source may satisfy this condition (FR-2.4). Unset means any source, in configured priority order.

days.description: Day tokens or ranges: MON, SAT, MON-FRI.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Required, and never taken from the server clock: a policy that means office hours in Bangkok must not change meaning when the pod moves region.

principals.description: OR list. Matching any entry satisfies this part of the predicate.

expression.description: Free-form predicate parsed by the ANTLR grammar, for comparisons that need both sides at once: user.country equals asset.prop(dataResidency), user.department in asset.domains, user.email in asset.owners. This is what lets one policy cover the whole organisation (FR-2A.4).
